Config program instruction processing and account update logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the instruction processor for the Solana `Config` program inside the executor. The main entry point, [`fd_config_program_execute`](<#fd_config_program_execute>), rejects execution when the `migrate_config_program_to_core_bpf` feature is active, charges the instruction with `DEFAULT_COMPUTE_UNITS`, and then calls [`_process_config_instr`](<#_process_config_instr>) to handle the program logic. The code uses the executor context, borrowed account handles, and bincode decode helpers to read the instruction data and the current config account state.

The [`_process_config_instr`](<#_process_config_instr>) function validates the instruction format, checks that the config account is owned by `fd_solana_config_program_id`, and enforces the signature rules for the keys stored in the account and in the new instruction data. It also rejects duplicate keys, checks that the number of required signers is met, and then writes the new config key list into the config account data. The file defines the program execution path and the external interface used by the executor to run `Config` program instructions.
